headline: Paraguay's Ueno Bank Collapse Triggers President's Impeachment and Arrest
summary: Following the dramatic collapse of Ueno Bank, Paraguay's Senate voted to impeach President Santiago Peña, leading to his removal and house arrest as authorities begin depositor repayments under a new government.
why: Banking crises and sudden political upheaval create severe sovereign risk and disrupt financial intermediation in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A banking failure combined with presidential impeachment introduces acute political and financial instability.
